story.heading:
Life, in
good company.
story.text: Pupit & Co is a brand of accessories for walks with dogs. We are starting with a dispenser that brings together water, food and a space for waste. To keep the essentials by your side.
story.alt: A dispenser and accessories ready for a walk
story.intro: We believe in everyday walks. In taking the essentials and coming home with a little more.
story.less_text: One dispenser for water, food and waste. All the essentials in your hand.
story.moments_text: Fewer complications, more time outside. Enjoy every walk without distractions.
story.company_text: To accompany their world. Because the best days are always together.

faq.contents_answer: 3-in-1 dispenser, grey carry cord and lower waste compartment.
faq.capacity_question: How much water and food does it hold?
faq.capacity_answer: The water reservoir holds 400 ml and the food compartment holds 150 ml. Food weight in grams depends on the food.
faq.launch_question: When will it be available to buy?
faq.launch_answer: We are preparing the launch. Leave your email on the waiting list and we will let you know when the dispenser is ready.
faq.price_question: Is there a launch date and price?
faq.price_answer: We have not published a date or final price yet. We will share both when the launch is ready.

seo.home: Pupit & Co. Accessories for walks in good company. Discover our 3-in-1 water, food and waste dispenser and join the launch waiting list.
seo.dispensador: Meet the Pupit & Co 3-in-1 walking dispenser: 400 ml of water, 150 ml for food and a separate space for waste. Sky blue and pink.
seo.productos: One 3-in-1 dispenser, two colours. Discover sky blue and pink from Pupit & Co and choose your favourite for the next walk.
seo.nosotros: Pupit & Co: a simple idea to carry the essentials and enjoy walks in good company. Meet our brand.
seo.paseos: The best part is going out together. Explore the world of Pupit & Co walks and prepare water, food and a space for waste.
seo.contact: Contact Pupit & Co about the 3-in-1 dispenser, the launch or a collaboration. Find answers to frequently asked questions.
